title: 외국법자문사법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00012:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 10 (Issuance of Decision)
① When the Legal Affairs Bureau disciplinary committee makes a decision regarding disciplinary action, it must issue a decision. The decision must include the order and the reasons, and must be signed or stamped by the chairperson and any committee members involved in the deliberation.
② The secretary must prepare the deliberation record and sign or stamp it together with the chairperson.
③ The result of the disciplinary decision must be delivered to the person for whom disciplinary action was requested, and separately notified to the Korean Bar Association and the person who requested the disciplinary action.
